Docs.summary: Provides Wi-Fi Aware service discovery, peer messaging, pairing, and data path APIs.

remarks.para: Use to attach to Wi-Fi Aware, then use to publish or subscribe to services. Discovery callbacks identify peers for message exchange and data path requests without an existing Wi-Fi access point connection.

Check device support and current availability before starting a session. Use to check optional capabilities, such as pairing and supported cipher suites. API availability alone does not establish device support.
